title: Word Formation: The Rise of Electric Cars (poziom rejonowy/wojewodzki)

tasks.instruction: Przeczytaj ponizszy tekst. Uzupelnij kazda luke (1.1-1.8), przeksztalcajac wyraz podany w ramce w taka forme, ktora logicznie i gramatycznie pasuje do kontekstu. Wymagana jest calkowita poprawnosc gramatyczna i ortograficzna wpisywanych wyrazow. Dwa wyrazy zostaly podane dodatkowo i nie pasuja do zadnej luki.
tasks.text: Over the past decade, the number of electric cars on the world's roads has grown 1.1. _________. Major car 1.2. _________ such as Tesla, Volkswagen and BYD now compete to build vehicles that are more 1.3. _________ friendly than traditional ones. For everyday use, drivers want a battery that is 1.4. _________ enough to cover long distances without breaking down. One surprising feature of these cars is that they are almost completely 1.5. _________, gliding through city streets in near silence. Many 1.6. _________ around the world now offer financial incentives to encourage people to switch. As demand rises, public 1.7. _________ are appearing in car parks and along motorways so that batteries can be refilled on long journeys. The dream is to make clean transport 1.8. _________ for ordinary families, not just the wealthy.
